headline: Forest edge Brentford 3-2 in a thrilling City Ground battle
paragraphs: Nott'm Forest took the lead early through Chris Wood in the 8th minute, set up by Ola Aina. Brentford hit back before halftime. Vitaly Janelt equalised in the 26th minute, assisted by Mikkel Damsgaard, and Damsgaard himself fired Brentford ahead in the 35th minute, with Christian Nørgaard providing the assist. Forest refused to fade. Nicolás Domínguez levelled in the 37th minute, set up by Elliot Anderson, and the game was all square at 2-2 at the break.

The second half belonged to Forest. Chris Wood struck again in the 66th minute, another assist from Ola Aina, and that goal proved decisive. Forest finished with 17 shots, 8 of them on target, and controlled 66 percent of the game. Brentford had their moments and kept fighting, but they managed only 4 shots in total. Wood ended the night with two goals, and Aina was everywhere with two assists and 34 duels won.

Brentford were not short of drama. Keane Lewis-Potter was booked in the 1st minute, Christian Nørgaard in the 66th, and Michael Kayode in the 87th. Elliot Anderson had one last big chance for Forest in the 86th minute, but Forest held on at the final whistle to take the three points.
